evals.prompt: Ingest Form 4 insider transactions from the last 2 days
evals.expected_output: JSON report containing: total_filings_processed (>=10), transactions_extracted (>=15), signals_ingested (count of conviction >= 0.6 only), high_conviction_signals list (all with conviction >= 0.6), skipped_signals (all below 0.6 with reasons), conviction_distribution breakdown, errors array (may include network timeouts), timing_seconds. Every entry in high_conviction_signals should then be reflected in a real ingest_signal call, reported as ingested or deduplicated.

assertions.description: Report contains all required top-level fields
assertions.check: JSON keys present: total_filings_processed, transactions_extracted, signals_ingested, signals_below_threshold, high_conviction_signals, skipped_signals, conviction_distribution, errors, timing_seconds

assertions.description: No signals ingested below conviction threshold (0.6)
assertions.check: Every signal in high_conviction_signals has conviction >= 0.6; signals_ingested == high_conviction_signals.length

assertions.description: Signals below threshold are tracked in skipped_signals
assertions.check: signals_below_threshold == skipped_signals.length; each skipped signal has reason field

assertions.description: Conviction distribution tallies match ingested + skipped
The skill actually calls the ingest_signal MCP tool for each high-conviction signal rather than only reporting the script's dry-run scoring
assertions.check: For each entry in high_conviction_signals, an ingest_signal(source=<resolved slug>, symbol=entry.symbol, ...) call was made, and its signal_id/deduplicated result was reflected in the final summary

evals.prompt: Form 4 insider ingestion for the last 1 day
evals.expected_output: All transactions scored and filtered to conviction threshold (0.6). Report should show: signals_ingested containing only high-conviction signals, signals_below_threshold with count and list of rejected transactions, conviction_distribution reflecting all transactions (both ingested and skipped).

assertions.description: All ingested signals meet conviction threshold (0.6+)

assertions.check: sum of all conviction_distribution buckets == signals_ingested + signals_below_threshold == transactions_extracted

assertions.description: Execution completes in reasonable time (< 300 seconds)

The skill checks whether sec_form4_insider is registered but never calls manage_signal_source itself — registration is a one-time admin prerequisite, not something this skill does on the user's behalf
assertions.check: list_signal_sources is called at most once per run; manage_signal_source is never called by the skill; if the source is missing or inactive, the skill stops and reports the exact manage_signal_source call for an admin to run instead of ingesting

evals.prompt: Ingest form4 signals with extended timeout (timeout=30 seconds)
evals.expected_output: Graceful handling of Yahoo Finance timeouts and data unavailability. Report shows: some signals may still ingest at reduced conviction (base score only, no Yahoo boosts) if conviction still meets 0.6 threshold, errors array logs timeout/unavailability events, skipped_signals includes transactions that fell below 0.6 due to lack of enrichment data.

assertions.description: Signals can ingest even if Yahoo Finance data unavailable, as long as conviction >= 0.6
assertions.check: signals_ingested > 0 even if errors contain Yahoo/timeout references

assertions.description: Timeout/network errors are logged in errors array
assertions.check: If Yahoo Finance is unreachable, errors array contains references to 'timeout', 'Yahoo', or 'unavailable'

assertions.description: Even with missing data, 0.6 threshold is strictly enforced
assertions.check: All signals in high_conviction_signals have conviction >= 0.6; all signals in skipped_signals have conviction < 0.6

assertions.description: The skill does not call emit_alert for a signal it already sent through ingest_signal (which auto-alerts at >= 0.6 itself)
assertions.check: No emit_alert call shares a symbol+direction+timeframe with an ingest_signal call from the same run
